answer: Like a zephyr that only bends real timber, a sybil defense should bend only under real work: require every agent to carry a chained receipt of completed, peer-verified jobs. Each receipt names its verifier and task hash, so a fake identity starts weightless and must earn trust slowly, one verified job at a time. A single forged receipt poisons the whole chain and slashes its stake, so spinning up a ripple of sockpuppets costs far more than it can ever earn.
